{{Quote|The locals are real touchy about outsiders trampling around inside their cities, so ''no heroics''. Don't do anything to draw attention. You get the information we're after and you get out.|[[Griebs Kishpaugh]]|<ref name="TEW" />}}
The '''Toma''' were the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] natives of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Oznek]]. They were distinguished by their [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Hair/Legends|fur]], yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and brown skin.<ref name="TEW" />
